title: Turkiye holds military ceremony for Libyan army chief killed in crash
summary: Turkish Defence Minister Yasar Guler and military chief Selcuk Bayraktaroglu attend ceremony at an airbase near Ankara.

title: Russia Strikes Kyiv a Day Before Zelenskiy-Trump Meeting
summary: Russian forces hit Ukraine’s capital with a massive airstrike on the eve of talks between Volodymyr Zelenskiy and Donald Trump aimed at nailing down a plan to end Moscow’s war.
